note: The two sets are nearly identical in content and accuracy; the only difference is that Set A repeats the 15-minute decathlete visit claim a second time ('decathlete | minimum visit duration'), which Set B omits. Both sets bind values correctly and keep key conditions (movie night suspension of Rule 11-1, the -50 to 0 kWh reduced-points band), but both also contain internal duplicates (4 houses per neighborhood stated twice, the -50 kWh no-points threshold stated twice, 5 neighborhoods stated twice) and a trivial axis-label claim. Set B is marginally cleaner because it carries one fewer redundant claim, with no loss of engineering content.
remarks: Both sets miss the full-points threshold (net electrical energy balance of at least 0 kWh earns all available points), the 10:30 p.m. score submission deadline, and the fact that the nine scores are averaged and multiplied by maximum available points. Both also duplicate the same facts under different names (neighborhood/village counts, no-points threshold). The 'x-axis' claim is a figure label of little engineering use. Note the text says reduced points apply 'between -50 kWh and 0 kWh' while Figure 10 states the band strictly as -50 kWh < energy < 0 kWh; neither set flags this.
